<thought>We have retrieved polymorphs for 20 oxide compositions so far. To meet the requirement of up to 40 compositions, we will retrieve polymorphs for the next 10 compositions (TiO, V2O5, WO3, MoO3, ZrO2, HfO2, GeO2, In2O3, Ga2O3, Y2O3) using the same energy and count limits. After that, we will retrieve the final 10 compositions (La2O3, CeO2, Nd2O3, Sm2O3, Gd2O3, Ti3O5, SiO, Al2O5, FeO, Fe3O4) and finally consolidate all 40 JSON files into a single dataset, returning its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": ["TiO", "V2O5", "WO3", "MoO3", "ZrO2", "HfO2", "GeO2", "In2O3", "Ga2O3", "Y2O3"],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
